summary: Pole Mountain lookout was a ground cabin: a log cabin in 1921, a cupola cabin listed in 1930, gone by 1955 in St. Joe National Forest.

facts.design: Log cabin in 1921, with a cupola cabin listed in 1930
facts.status_note: Gone by 1955; no source describes remains

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as hike-in; no source describes the site today or whether visitors may go there

events.note: Log cabin, a quarter mile west
Cupola cabin listed; the sources do not say whether it replaced the 1921 cabin
Listed as gone; the sources give no cause

evidence.supports: Log cabin a quarter mile west in 1921, cupola cabin in 1930, gone in 1955
evidence.quote: 1921: log cabin 1/4 mile west. 1930: cupola cabin. Patrol 3 miles SSE. Gone 1955.

evidence.supports: Six miles southwest of Red Ives ranger station
evidence.quote: 6 miles southwest of Red Ives R.S.

evidence.supports: Ground site, gone, in the regional register

notes_for_editor: Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give the 1955 loss; the Forest Lookouts entry gives only the 1921 log cabin and the 1930 cupola cabin, and the register confirms the site is a gone ground site. The brief's kind 'ground' is confirmed by the regional register. No staffing, fire, cause-of-loss or access information was found. Whether the 1930 cupola cabin replaced the 1921 cabin is not stated, so the story does not say so.
